created_prompt: Hello I require your help to create a fool-proof solid three-year plan for Julie. Julie posts cooking videos to 1.2m followers. She wants to grow larger, publish a cookbook (although she is unsure whether to use an agent who has reached out to her or self-publish), and blog about mixing recipes with travel stories from a time she visited France. Her cooking videos focus on quick, healthy recipes but her France trip was a lot more indulgent food wise. Julie works four days per week, recently adopted a child and has limited time/budget. Julie finds the fast-changing field overwhelming, but has wants to chieve her goals within a 3 year time period.
